options.content:
Every kepler.gl layer type this panel can build from query rows, on synthetic data around Cuenca. Each map is pinned to exactly one layer by a saved map configuration, and the table beside it shows the rows behind that layer — read from the map panel itself, not queried twice.

**Narrow `zona` in a map's own filter panel**, on the left, and the whole gallery follows — every other map and every table. The `Zona` picker at the top does the same from the other side.

Dashboard time sync is off on every panel, trips included — see `timesync` and `timevars` for that.

**Open at most two rows at a time.** Each map holds two WebGL contexts and browsers cap them at around sixteen; all five rows at once blanks the oldest maps.

Not shown: `vectorTile`, `rasterTile`, `wms`, `tile3d`, `bitmap` and `3D`. Those are configured with a URL rather than with data, so no query can drive them.

title: Kepler.gl layer gallery
